scope: All current product surfaces and fork-specific regressions. Catalogue membership is not a passing test result.
history_scope: Four retained workstation rollouts and stored history for 15 named Odysseus threads, including October 21/24/25/30 and November 4/6/7. Debian host had no retained Codex rollouts; copied workbench context is supplementary, not a substitute for logs.

history.summary: Older work recap reported empty successful network-filesystem writes.
Older work recap reported Stop leaving background processes alive.
Older work recap reported nested fences truncating commands and Windows newline rewriting.
Earlier runtime investigation found TLS trust differences between Python, Chromium and gRPC.
Earlier Jev campaign stopped on a malformed distribution; remaining attempts were not executed.
Older BYOK validation reported Google HTTP 400 and incomplete live-provider coverage.
Missing approval control, intrusive refresh, unclear decisions and missing default workspace were reported.
A live file write was blocked by the former blanket 95 percent assessment threshold.
Saved recap recorded CI failures around service-worker and stylesheet expectations.
New chats lost Auto settings and showed a stale Gemini 2.5 identity or unsupported effort.
Sidebar text/icons, drag responsiveness and scroll-driven scaling/rendering were reported.
Long composer text hid model controls and the permission menu flickered.
Context panel displayed the bootstrap model instead of the effective execution model.
Gemma thought-tag reasoning triggered a false action guard and concatenated greetings.
Native file cycle encountered reservation mismatch, missing runtime Bubblewrap, unsupported tool names and provider 429.
OpenAI key was added; persisted-key catalogue refresh passed but inference had not been tested.

Initial runner assumptions misread an unselected workspace, no-op CAS revision, canonical round_models evidence and inherited Auto routing. These were harness defects; pin provider probes without changing owner defaults.

cases.steps: Have provider claim success after a failed/no-op action, then supply real matching receipt.
cases.expected: Missing/failed evidence cannot become success; correct actual outcome may complete.
cases.evidence: Exact source/environment, observed state or execution receipt, result and cleanup; browser cases also require desktop/mobile captures.

cases.preconditions: Qualified sandboxed Chromium private-pipe profile, otherwise explicitly blocked.
cases.steps: Exercise success/failure/cancellation and export metadata for one synthetic run.
cases.expected: Owner/run IDs, timings, usage and policy revision align; no hidden chain of thought or credentials.
cases.evidence: Exact source/environment, observed state or execution receipt, result and cleanup; browser cases also require desktop/mobile captures.

cases.title: Preferences across logins
cases.preconditions: Disposable state copy for backup/import/reset; preserve real deployment and credentials.
cases.steps: Change one synthetic preference, log out and read via new login, then restore.
cases.expected: Acknowledged setting persists and unrelated owner/model/approval state stays unchanged.
cases.evidence: Exact source/environment, observed state or execution receipt, result and cleanup; browser cases also require desktop/mobile captures.
